snippet.title: S.T.A.L.K.E.R.2: Heart of Chornobyl — Accolades Trailer
snippet.description:
Praised for its atmosphere, gripping narrative, and unforgiving survival mechanics, S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chornobyl has captured adventurers' hearts worldwide. But the true magic of the Zone lies in experiencing it first-hand!
